notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v1.0.3
notes.content:
[h1][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Updated [b]lottery[/b] spawn : now tickets can be discovered on the ground using [b]Detective Mode[/b]. Collecting them gives a chance to win prizes ranging from small to large.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue in [b]Quest : A Missing Key[/b] where sometimes you couldn’t continue talking to [b]Jack[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where [b]H-scene during CCTV viewing[/b] did not sync correctly with the intended animation.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v1.0.2 – Game Improvements
notes.content: [h1][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Increased the [b]spawn rate of money on the ground[/b], making it easier for players to collect.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]minigame reward rates[/b], granting higher rewards across all minigames.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - LCF1 1.0.1
notes.content: [h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Resolved an issue where players could get stuck in the quests [b]“Pervert Is Back”[/b] and [b]“Take A Photo Of Him”[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some normal cutscenes that [b]glitch[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]characters disappeared[/b] in certain scenes.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]furniture shop items failed to display[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update Version 1.0
notes.content: [h1][b]Artwork[/b][/h1][list][*][p]All pixel artwork across the game has been completely updated for improved quality and style. The Mart shop artwork has been refined to make it clearer when the special wine appears, reducing player confusion. [/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Minigames[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Refreshed all [b]minigame artwork.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Updated [b]the minigame UI[/b] for a smoother and more accessible gameplay experience.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h1]Quest Log[/h1][list][*][p]Added clearer descriptions and additional details to quests for better understanding.[/p][/*][*][p]“Finding” quests now include color indicators:[/p][list][*][p][b]Green[/b] – already discovered[/p][/*][*][p][b]Red[/b] – not yet discovered[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]This feature helps players track progress and reduces confusion.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Gameplay[/h1][list][*][p]Introduced a map icon in [b]LCF1[/b] for faster access to the map menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Players can now press [b]"TAB" [/b] to open the coffee slot.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new icon for [b]The Office[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Motel[/b] does not support fast travel and must still be accessed through the park as usual.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the daily activity schedules of certain characters to make them easier to find.[/p][/*][*][p]Add [b]girls icons on the world map[/b] so players can easily see where each girl is located at different times.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1][b]H Scenes[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]H scenes[/b] are now replayable by speaking with the girls in-game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - LCF1 0.31-b
notes.content: [h1][b]Bug Fix[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Addressed a recurring issue where certain [b]female character CGs[/b] would appear [b]black[/b] in specific scenes, as previously reported.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v0.31-a – Game Improvements
notes.content: [h1][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Adjusted the quest [b]"Glad You Are Back"[/b] so that the wait time changes from [b]1–2 days[/b] to [b]the next day[/b], allowing players to start the main storyline sooner.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an extra spawn schedule for [b]Hanna[/b] - she will now also appear [b]on Wednesday morning at the park[/b].[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Hotfix - LCF1 0.30-b
notes.content: [h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where after finishing a [b]female character's CG,[/b] the screen sometimes got stuck on black and the game became unresponsive.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed missing dialogue during some [b]female characters' CGs[/b] so the CG can proceed normally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed [b]Hanna’s[/b] location info not displaying properly; now it shows again as intended.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a redundant [b]"Bye"[/b] button appeared when talking to certain characters.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]SPOILER WARNING:[/b][/p][p]Corrected the quest description for "Go To Motel" quest where the motel code was mistakenly set as 163 it has been fixed to 136.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v0.30-a – Game Improvements
notes.content: [h1][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Quest: "Clean It All"[/b] – For players who missed this quest during the mid-game story, it will now be automatically granted after completing all of [b]Emilia’s[/b] quests, allowing an additional [b]Emilia CG[/b] to be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "Talk to Emilia 3"[/b] – Updated the quest description to better reflect the actual completion requirements.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Quest: "Janitor"[/b] – Reduced the trash collection requirement from [b]5[/b] to [b]3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "Big Cleaning"[/b] – Reduced the trash collection requirement from [b]10[/b] to [b]5[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "Winner"[/b] – Reduced the requirement to defeat Watson from [b]5[/b] times to [b]3[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "Winner Winner Chicken Dinner"[/b] – Reduced the requirement to defeat Watson from [b]10[/b] times to [b]5[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Pull-Ups Minigame[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Quest: "Test of the Power"[/b] – Increased Hanna’s pull-up power delay from [b]0.6s → 0.85s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "A Final Showdown"[/b] – Increased Hanna’s pull-up power delay from [b]0.575s → 0.8s[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tip:[/b] It’s recommended to purchase the [b]"Super Pill"[/b] from the [b]bar[/b] before attempting these quests for an easier experience.[b]Game Improvements[/b][/p][h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1][list][*][p][b]Quest: "What Are You Hiding?"[/b] – Fixed an issue where the key would not appear in the inventory after being picked up ([b]players who have already collected it before this fix will need to pick it up again[/b]).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "What Are You Hiding?"[/b] – Fixed a bug where the [b]Detective Sight[/b] size would not scale properly after upgrading.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v0.20-d – Balance & Game Improvements
notes.content: [h3][b]Balance Changes[/b][/h3][p][b]Pull-Ups Minigame[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Quest: "Test of the Power"[/b] – Increased Hanna’s pull-up power delay from [b]0.45s → 0.6s[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Quest: "A Final Showdown"[/b] – Increased Hanna’s pull-up power delay from [b]0.3s → 0.575s[/b].[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][b]Tip:[/b] It’s recommended to purchase the [b]"Super Pill"[/b] from the [b]bar[/b] before attempting these quests for an easier experience.[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix - LCF1 0.20-c
notes.content: [h1][b]Bugfixes [/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI could occasionally disappear after completing certain minigames and skipping a week.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where pressing [b]E[/b] to interact during conversations in the shop still allowed further interaction, even while the shop UI was active.[/p][/*][/list][h1][b]Game Improvements [/b][/h1][list][*][p]Updated the [b]frame rate lock system[/b] to match your monitor’s refresh rate, reducing potential FPS stuttering issues.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the [b]quest log[/b] to now show which [b]character's story must progress[/b] before the next quest becomes available.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v0.20-b – Game Improvements & Bug Fixes
notes.content: [h3][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Increased [b]player walking speed[/b] across all scenes for a smoother experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bin Minigame [/b][/p][p]- Added [b]outline to trash objects[/b] to make them easier to distinguish.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Camera Minigame [/b][/p][p]- Increased [b]button size[/b] for easier interaction.[/p][p]- Balanced the [b]pulling force of the green box[/b] to feel more responsive and fair.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Pull-Up Minigame[/b][/p][p]- Made the [b]pull-up challenge in the "A Final Showdown" quest[/b] easier to complete.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]disconnecting during the Cafe Minigame early in the game[/b] would cause the next conversation with [b]Molly[/b] to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, on [b]21:9 ultrawide monitors[/b], the [b]Settings UI[/b] would become unresponsive.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 v0.20-a – Balance & Game Improvements
notes.content: [h3][b]Balance Changes (Upgrade Items)[/b][/h3][p]Adjusted prices for several [b]Upgrade Items[/b]:[/p][list][*][p][b]Garbage Expert LV.MAX[/b]: 20,000 → [b]10,000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Clean Sense[/b]: 20,000 → [b]10,000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Super Pill[/b]: 20,000 → [b]10,000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Limit Break LV.1[/b]: 20,000 → [b]10,000[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Limit Break LV.MAX[/b]: 40,000 → [b]10,000[/b][/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Game Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Bin Minigame [/b]: Added a clear prompt showing the [b]type of trash[/b] to help players understand what to throw.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Cafe Minigame [/b]: Increased [b]button size[/b] for easier interaction.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Quest Descriptions[/b]: Rewritten to be [b]clearer and easier to understand[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]If you encounter any issues or unexpected behavior in the game, we recommend either restarting the game or returning to the main menu.[/b][/h3][p]If the problem persists, please consider reporting the bug to us. You can find the [b]“Report Bug”[/b] button on the [b]main menu[/b].[/p][p]Your feedback helps us improve the game. Thank you for your support![/p][p][/p]

notes.content:
[list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the UI would disappear after skipping a week.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "[b]Key Card" [/b]quest dialog would repeatedly trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]Polaroid[/b] and [b]Spy Camera[/b] items were not marked as “Sold Out” after being purchased and restarting the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected the button icon in laptop text from [b]"FanOnly"[/b] to [b]"FNZone" [/b]to stay on the safe side regarding copyright..[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue during the "Night Protein" quest that caused the men's bathroom door and item to disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in [b]"Talk to Flex"[/b] where [b]Toshi’s image[/b] would freeze and not display properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Emilia’s chair at the bar was missing.
[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Small Update – LCF1 0.19-a – New Feedback & Bug Report Buttons
notes.content: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p]We’ve added two new ways for you to communicate directly with us from inside the game:[/p][p][b]New Features[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Feedback Button[/b] – Share your ideas, suggestions, or requests for new features directly with the development team.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug Report Button[/b] – Quickly report any bugs or technical issues you encounter while playing.[/p][/*][/list][p]Your input helps us improve the game and make it even better. We’re looking forward to hearing your thoughts and fixing any problems you find![/p][p]Thanks for your support[/p]

notes.content:
[h1][b]Bugfixes
[/b][/h1][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the chair in the bar would disappear.[/p][/*][*][p]Quests can no longer be taken twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue in the [b]"New Customer"[/b] quest where players could get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]In the [b]"Place Hidden Camera"[/b] quest, players can now exit Emilia's room after completing the quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where pressing the Return button in the Bin game would cause the scene to loop repeatedly.[/p][/*][/list]
